import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformers

# Get the table
tbl = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create embedding index on the 'content' column
# Using sentence-transformers model 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
embedding_fn = sentence_transformers.using(model_id='sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
tbl.add_embedding_index('content', embedding=embedding_fn, if_exists='replace')

# Run semantic search query
query_text = "climate change policy"
sim = tbl.content.similarity(string=query_text)

# Select rows ordered by similarity, return top 5
results = tbl.select(tbl.content, sim).order_by(sim, asc=False).limit(5).collect()

# Display results
for i, row in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"{i}. Similarity: {row['content_similarity']:.4f}")
    print(f"   Content: {row['content'][:100]}...\n")

import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the table
tbl = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create embedding index on the 'content' column
# Using sentence-transformers model 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
embedding_fn = sentence_transformers.using(model_id='sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
tbl.add_embedding_index('content', embedding=embedding_fn, if_exists='replace')

# Run semantic search query
query_text = "climate change policy"
sim = tbl.content.similarity(string=query_text)

# Select rows ordered by similarity, return top 5
results = tbl.select(tbl.content, sim).order_by(sim, asc=False).limit(5).collect()

# Display results
for i, row in enumerate(results, 1):
